title: SIMV: flow starvation on the mandatory breaths, comfort on the supported ones
summary: ARDS with a strong drive on SIMV-VC: 12 mandatory volume breaths a minute at a fixed 40 L/min, pressure support 12 in between. The mandatory breaths are scooped and short of what the patient pulls for; the supported breaths, where flow follows demand, look nothing like them. One patient, two breath types, one trace.
objectives: Spot the scooped, concave pressure ramp on the mandatory breaths and its absence on the supported breaths.
Fix the mandatory breaths: raise the peak flow (or switch the base to pressure control), and bring the mandatory rate closer to the patient's own, so flow meets demand.

fix.note: Mandatory breaths in pressure control (Pinsp 16, Ti 1.0 s) at a mandatory rate of 13: flow now follows the demand and the clock is closer to the patient's own rate.
